title: Ninja XXXL FlexDrawer Air Fryer, 10.4L Dual Zone $217.55 (RRP $449.99) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Ninja XXXL FlexDrawer Air Fryer, 10.4L Dual Zone $217.55 (RRP $449.99) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[sol3x] Does anyone what material of the inside layer is? Is it just plastic or metal?
[dtpearson] Not sure how plastic would hold up to +200 degrees. Its metal with a non-stick coating like most cookware these days.
[Satchimo] Tupperware has/had a range of plastic oven roasting dishes that go up to 250c. Something something used similar stuff that they used on the tiles on the space shuttle. It was called Ovenworks.
[kingmoron] i got this 6 months ago even after reported issues. got it and it immediately was broken(the sensor for one of the doors didnt work. buyer beware
[dtpearson] Hmm, been using it for 12 months daily and still going great for me.
[nitens] This only has one door. Sure you're talking about the same unit?
[profane01] Interesting you say "one of the doors", because this model only has 1. You may be referring to the AF400?
[Mickey333] There is a newer model whereby the trays open individually
[nitens] I have one of these and I don't understand how that would work. Link?
[profane01] There is the SL400 (DoubleStack) which is newer. Some of us want the larger tray though
[anttheknee] We have this unit and it’s fantastic. Warning: the drawer is MASSIVE and can be quite hard / clunky to clean in a small sink or dishwasher. We bought cheap silicone inserts from Amazon as they’re a lot easier to clean. The food still (miraculously) comes out crispy when needed (e.g., potato gems, hash browns, fries, etc.).
[coldazure] Can you share a link to those inserts? Have you done any research on the safety of these inserts?
[Bertg] I use one of these daily, Roasts, Taters, Prawn dishes, Vege dishes etc. Never had a problem except for a small burn or two reaching across the drawer to turn items, twice burnt wide awake now hahaha. I would be lost without it, cheers
